title: Open-closed short exact sequence on the pro-etale site
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme, let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion and $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ the inclusion of the complementary open subscheme [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], and assume that $j$ is quasi-compact. Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring. On the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] let $i^*,j^*$ be the inverse images and $i_*$ the direct image of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], and $j_!$ the extension by zero [def-weil-extension-by-zero]. Then for every sheaf $\mathcal F$ of $\Lambda_X$-modules on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ the sequence
$$
0\longrightarrow j_!j^*\mathcal F\longrightarrow\mathcal F\longrightarrow i_*i^*\mathcal F\longrightarrow0,
$$
whose first map is the counit of $j_!\dashv j^*$ and whose second map is the unit of $i^*\dashv i_*$, is exact.
